p1.title:
JTEKT Internship
Sovereign RAG Engine
& Industrial Generative AI
p1.desc: Challenge: Instantly access over 450 complex technical documentations and engineering reports, with an absolute constraint of sovereignty and industrial confidentiality (zero data leaks, formal ban on using public Cloud APIs).
p1.c1: Local LLMs & Sovereignty: On-premise deployment of open-source models via Ollama (Llama 3, Mistral) for local processing without external dependencies.
p1.c2: Dense Vector Indexing: Semantic vectorization with FAISS for instant semantic searches on technical corpuses.
p1.c3: Hybrid Pipeline & RRF: Combination of lexical and dense search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) reranking for maximum documentary precision.
p1.c4: Ingestion & APIs: Data ingestion/cleaning interfaces and scripts developed in Python via REST API connected to business repositories.

p2.title:
JTEKT Internship
Teleport Zero Trust Bastion
& System Hardening
p2.desc: Challenge: Replace direct and heterogeneous SSH accesses with a unified, auditable access model that complies with industrial cybersecurity requirements.
p2.c1: Zero Trust Access Plane: Deployment and configuration of the Teleport access bastion based on ephemeral certificates (mTLS/SSH).
p2.c2: Governance & Auditing: Elimination of shared static SSH keys, granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and continuous video recording of administration sessions.
p2.c3: Hardening: Hardening of 15 Linux Debian 12 servers in production (service isolation via chroot, fine-grained privilege management via POSIX ACLs, and closing of attack vectors).

p3.title:
JTEKT Internship
Network Access Control
802.1X NAC & Automation
p3.desc: Challenge: Securing the physical access layer against intrusion and MAC spoofing, with dynamic segmentation and automation of industrial flows.
p3.c1: 802.1X NAC Deployment: Strong authentication via machine certificate (EAP-TLS) and centralized MAB on NPS server (RADIUS) with AD CS infrastructure.
p3.c2: Cisco Switching: Dynamic flow segmentation on 24 Cisco 2960-X switches (strict isolation between office, industrial, and IoT flows).
p3.c3: Operations Automation: Design of a suite of 12 Python and Bash scripts to automate infrastructure operations tasks, service interconnection, and IT hygiene audits.

p4.title:
JTEKT Internship
Secure SFTP Infrastructure
& Migration Automation
p4.desc: Context: Complete automation of the migration from a legacy FileZilla server to a secure Debian 12 environment. Development of an XML parsing script in Python and automated deployment scripts in Bash.
p4.c1: Systems & Automation: Full migration from FileZilla to secure Debian 12 via Python (XML parsing) and Bash (deployment) scripts.
p4.c2: Storage & Security: 1 TB dedicated volume, isolation via SFTP chroots, and fine-grained privilege management using system POSIX ACLs.
p4.c3: Persistence: Automated bind mounts via custom systemd (.mount) units.
